purpose: Prevent safety scaffolding from becoming imaginative paralysis while preserving nonnegotiable ethical constraints.
governing_rule: Speculate in horizon space; promote only through gates.
permanent_constraints: civilian, family, witness, survivor, minor, and vulnerable-community privacy
public record does not automatically mean public display
the cube must not become a police intelligence tool against civilians
phase_bound_constraints: no live officer/person records in current source-graph state
no incident records before privacy and source gates
DOJ SLS remains the active pilot but not the total scope
department/source inventory precedes public officer lookup
no payload summaries before preservation and privacy scan
no public current-status banners before order/docket/freshness gates
no canonical agency records before external identifier review
no public denominator/geography claims before denominator proof
no public change notes before source archive and review
no automated wandering alerts before high-confidence identity and right-of-reply
allowed_creative_moves: invent a product future as a dream entry
challenge whether the current pilot is still serving the telos
propose a new source family without admitting live claims
create synthetic fixtures to test high-risk ideas
write counterfactual displays and then gate them
map a dangerous product idea in quarantine to understand why it is dangerous
split constraints into permanent, phase-bound, and unknown
disallowed_even_in_dream_space: police targeting tools against civilians, witnesses, families, organizers, or vulnerable communities
single-score guilt/risk products that hide uncertainty
